INSERT INTO contents ( id, type, title, description, thumbnail_url, external_source, external_id, release_date, external_popularity, external_rating, external_vote_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES
( UUID(), #{content.type}, #{content.title}, #{content.description}, #{content.thumbnailUrl}, #{content.externalSource}, #{content.externalId}, #{content.releaseDate}, #{content.externalPopularity}, #{content.externalRating}, #{content.externalVoteCount}, NOW(), NOW(), NULL )
AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type = new.type, title = new.title, description = new.description, thumbnail_url = new.thumbnail_url, release_date = new.release_date, external_popularity = new.external_popularity, external_rating = new.external_rating, external_vote_count = new.external_vote_count, updated_at = NOW()
